summary: Defines MIBs for performing ping, traceroute and lookup operations at a remote host. When managing a network, it is useful to start these operations on another machine and retrieve the results. The lookup capability helps map names or addresses. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Instead of testing the road from your own house, you ask a friend across town to test it and report back. This lets a management tool do that with ping and traceroute.

questions: how to run ping remotely with snmp
